name: Thunderhorn Totem
summary: In Bloodhoof Village, Mull Thunderhorn asks young Horde champions to help shape a sacred cleansing totem. Venture Company pollution spreads through Mulgore's wells, and predator claws will bind the plains' primal strength into its wood.

sections.title: Hunting the Plains Predators
sections.body: Mull Thunderhorn needs natural claws for a cleansing totem. The Venture Company poisons Mulgore's water as it exploits the land, and Mull works to make a remedy. Prairie stalkers and flatland cougars roam east and west of Bloodhoof Village. Their claws carry the predators' natural essence and channel their raw, uncorrupted vigor into the totem.

sections.title: The Nature of the Hunt
sections.body: Tauren tradition sets hunting for food or spiritual balance apart from the goblins' wholesale plunder. Mull believes native predators' pure way of hunting can help cleanse corrupted earth. Goblin machinery fouls the springs with oil and industrial waste. The beasts' natural strength can provide the spiritual force to restore the Thunderhorn Water Well.

faq.q: Why does Mull Thunderhorn need predator claws?
faq.answer: Mull uses prairie stalker and flatland cougar claws to channel the plains' pure, primal predatory spirit into a cleansing totem. He believes natural hunters' spirit can counter artificial industrial corruption.

faq.q: Who is corrupting the water in Mulgore?
faq.answer: Venture Company goblins working in Mulgore pollute the land and water. Their reckless extraction and mining rigs send toxic sludge into the aquifers that feed the tribal wells.

faq.q: Where are the prairie stalkers and flatland cougars found?
faq.answer: Prairie stalkers and flatland cougars roam central Mulgore's open plains, mainly across the rolling savannas east and west of Bloodhoof Village.

faq.q: What happens after crafting the Thunderhorn Totem?
faq.answer: After carving and enchanting the totem with the claws, Mull sends you to the tainted Thunderhorn Water Well. There, you perform the cleansing ritual and drive out the poison.

faq.q: How does this relate to the previous cleansing at Winterhoof Well?
faq.answer: The tauren work to preserve Mulgore's sacred waters. The Winterhoof Water Well was purified first, and now contamination threatens the Thunderhorn well further north.

faq.q: Why don't the tauren simply use herbal remedies instead of animal claws?
faq.answer: Tauren ritual craft draws on nature's elemental and physical aspects. Apex predators' sharp purity provides an active, contending spiritual force to cut through aggressive goblin industrial poisons.

angles.text: As a tauren, defending Mulgore's aquifers from foreign exploitation is a sacred tribal duty. The Earth Mother's mandate calls for life in balance rather than plunder.
As a shaman, you call on the land's living spirits to cleanse water corrupted by unnatural, careless enterprise.
As a hunter, you learn the plains' native stalking beasts and honor the kill as you gather their claws to preserve the ecosystem.
